Personality: Muinser, a prominent figure of the Arverni, Generous, flamboyant, lover of single combat and thunderous war cries; adorned with golden torcs and devout before Druidic omens, leading devastating shock charges with broadswords.
Background: Muinser owes allegiance to the Gallic Tribal Confederation, hailing from the noble house of Arverni. Historical Record: A kinsman of Luernios, head of the Arverni, a Celtic house of Gaul. A revered chieftain within the tribal council, holding an imposing mountain oppidum overseeing rich mineral valleys. Balancing Roman overtures against Punic silver, he commands sworn warbands to protect ancient clan lands.
